body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Withdrawn) A vehicle comprising:a steering wheel, a vehicle drive system, a driving mode paddle shifter coupled to the steering wheel, an output device, and an electronic control unit communicatively coupled to the driving mode paddle shifter, the vehicle drive system, and the output device, wherein the electronic control unit is configured to:
output a menu of driving mode options of the vehicle with the output device based on an operation of the driving mode paddle shifter, each of the driving mode options referring to a set of parameters that adjust at least one of the vehicle's economy, responsiveness, or traction;
navigate the menu of the driving mode options of the vehicle using the driving mode paddle shifter;
receive a drive mode shifting signal from the driving mode paddle shifter indicative of a selection of one of the driving mode options in the menu with the driving mode paddle shifter; and
change a parameter of the vehicle drive system in order to change a driving mode of the vehicle in response to the drive mode shifting signal.
2. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 1, wherein the output device comprises a heads-up- display.
3. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 1, wherein the output device comprises a display.
4. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 1, wherein the driving mode paddle shifter is a first paddle shifter, and the vehicle further comprises a second paddle shifter.
5. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 4, wherein:the output device comprises a display, and
actuating one of the first paddle shifter and the second paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to display the menu of driving mode options with the display.
6. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 4, wherein:the output device comprises a display,
actuating one of the first paddle shifter and the second paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to display the menu of driving mode options with the display,
shifting of the first paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to navigate the menu in a first direction, and
shifting of the second paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to navigate the menu in a second direction.
7. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 1, wherein:the output device comprises a display, and
actuating the driving mode paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to display the menu of driving mode options with the display.
8. (Withdrawn) The vehicle of claim 7, wherein shifting of the driving mode paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to navigate the menu.
9. (Currently Amended) A system for changing a driving mode of a vehicle, the system comprising:a steering wheel, a vehicle drive system, a plurality of driving mode paddle shifters coupled to the steering wheel, a sensor configured to output a driving environment signal indicative of a characteristic of a driving environment of the vehicle, an output device, and an electronic control unit communicatively coupled to the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters, the vehicle drive system, the sensor, and the output device, wherein the electronic control unit is configured to:
receive the driving environment signal from the sensor;
determine a recommended driving mode based on the driving environment signal from the sensor;
output a menu of driving mode options including the recommended driving mode with the output device in response to an operation of one of the plurality of paddle shifters, each of the driving mode options referring to a set of parameters that adjust at least one of the vehicle's economy, responsiveness, or traction;
navigate the menu of the driving mode options of the vehicle using one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters;
receive a drive mode shifting signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters indicative of a selection of one of the driving mode options in the menu with one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters;
change one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters from a first role to a second role in response to the selection of the driving mode, wherein the first role is a driving mode selector role and the second role is different from the first role;
remain in a current driving mode in response to no selection of the driving mode;and
change a parameter of the vehicle drive system in order to change the driving mode of the vehicle in response to the drive mode shifting signal.
10. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 9, wherein the electronic control unit is configured to:receive a response signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters in response to outputting the recommended driving mode; and
change the parameter of the vehicle drive system in order to change the driving mode of the vehicle to the recommended driving mode in response to receiving the response signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters indicative of approval of the recommended driving mode.
11. (Original) The system of claim 9, wherein the driving environment signal includes at least one of image data from one or more cameras, weather data, map data, driver habit data, and vehicle status data.
12. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 9, wherein the electronic control unit is further configured to:
receive an unprompted drive mode shifting signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters indicative of a desire to change the driving mode of the vehicle;
change the parameter of the vehicle drive system in order to change the driving mode in response to the unprompted drive mode shifting signal, and
provide a notification related to the change in the driving mode with the output device.
13. (Original) The system of claim 12, wherein:the output device comprises a display, and
the unprompted drive mode shifting signal causes the electronic control unit to display the menu of driving mode options with the display.
14. (Previously Presented) The system of claim 12, wherein the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters includes a first paddle shifter and a second paddle shifter.
15. (Original) The system of claim 14, wherein:the output device comprises a display,
the unprompted drive mode shifting signal causes the electronic control unit to display the menu of driving mode options with the display,
actuating of the first paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to navigate the menu in a first direction, and
actuating of the second paddle shifter causes the electronic control unit to navigate the menu in a second direction.
16. (Currently Amended) A method of changing a driving mode of a vehicle, the method comprising:outputting, with an electronic control unit, a menu of driving mode options including a recommended driving mode with an output device in response to an operation of one of a plurality of driving mode paddle shifters coupled to a vehicle steering wheel, each of the driving mode options referring to a set of parameters that adjust at least one of the vehicle's economy, responsiveness, or traction;
navigating the menu of the driving mode options of the vehicle using one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters;
receiving, with the electronic control unit, a drive mode shifting signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters coupled to the vehicle steering wheel indicative of a selection of one of the driving mode options in the menu with one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters;
changing one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters from a first role to a second role in response to the selection of the driving mode, wherein the first role is a driving mode selector role and the second role is different from the first role;
remaining in a current driving mode in response to no selection of the driving mode;and changing a parameter of a vehicle drive system in order to change the driving mode of the vehicle in response to receiving the drive mode shifting signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters.
17. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 16, further comprising changing two or more parameters of the vehicle drive system in order to change the driving mode in response to receiving the drive mode shifting signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters.
18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, further comprising changing one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters from a first role to a second role in response to the selection of the driving mode, wherein:in the first role, the electronic control unit changes the parameter of the vehicle drive system in response to the drive mode shifting signal, and
in the second role, the electronic control unit shifts gears of the vehicle in response to the drive mode shifting signal.
19. (Previously Presented) The method of claim 16, wherein:the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters comprises a first paddle shifter and a second paddle shifter,
and the drive mode shifting signal from one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters indicative of the selection of one of the driving mode options in the menu with one or more of the plurality of driving mode paddle shifters comprises actuating the first paddle shifter and the second paddle shifter in a predetermined sequence.
20. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the output device is a heads-up-display.
